title.zh: US weighs overseas push for dollar-backed stablecoins: Bloomberg
title.en: US weighs overseas push for dollar-backed stablecoins: Bloomberg

current_state.zh: The Trump administration is reportedly weighing an initiative involving several federal agencies and private-sector partners to expand the international use of dollar-backed stablecoins and thereby reinforce the dollar's reserve-currency status and demand for US Treasurys.
current_state.en: The Trump administration is reportedly weighing an initiative involving several federal agencies and private-sector partners to expand the international use of dollar-backed stablecoins and thereby reinforce the dollar's reserve-currency status and demand for US Treasurys.
